headline: On October 9, 1992: Meteorite Smashes Car
captionCards: 16 videos captured the 27.7 lb meteorite's fiery descent.
This 4.4 billion-year-old rock offers rare collision data.
instagramCaption:
A 27.7-pound rock fell from the sky and crushed a car in Peekskill, New York.

Sixteen video recordings captured the H6 monomict breccia burning through the atmosphere before it struck the vehicle. This stony meteorite, estimated to be 4.4 billion years old, contained tiny flakes of nickel-iron making up 20% of its mass.

Its well-documented impact provides rare data on asteroid collisions in outer space.
